note: Gate B W3 — B06 League/Event match comparison. Four candidates: League Before/After (confirms the shipped Match Details BEFORE/AFTER composition as the comparison baseline) and Event Before/After (a UI-Lab-local design proposal for a standalone Event Match Details layout, composed from real production pieces — not a production route). All four remain CANDIDATE pending owner review. A retrospective remediation (B3-R1 through B3-R7, same session as B05/W2's own retrospective fix) corrected League · After's and Event · After's fixtures/navigation (fixtureVersion 2) and League · Before's/Event · Before's coach-facing copy and navigation (no fixture data change, fixtureVersion unchanged), and added two new real origin pages (league/match-details, event/event-detail) — see docs/ui-lab/gate-b-w3-candidates/SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md and BLOCKERS.md. Fresh real CI capture evidence against the remediated revision is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39657393171 (reviewedBranchHeadSha 568096efc0f2d89b85eaaa90ad4b2fedf0b16612), 40 captures, all 40 hashes independently re-verified. The pre-remediation run (39637600700, 1c185cc01f8a6ee46f958792e0b04e8105f86b05, also 40 captures) is preserved for traceability under capture-attestation.json's own priorVersions[0] — it was CANDIDATE only and never approved, so nothing is inherited from it.
